Bowl ~15 cm with ~8 cantaloupe/papaya chunks (~180 g) over a layer of rice or coconut-like sticky rice (~100 g). Mango sticky rice style? The fruit looks like cantaloupe or papaya. Rice ~100 g at ~130–160 kcal/100 g gives ~150 kcal. Fruit ~180 g at 35 kcal/100 g gives ~65 kcal. Total ~215, rounded to ~220 kcal.
